title: Redstrike Cross-Model Dispatch Ledger
description: runtime/model_ledger.json -- the ACTUALLY DISPATCHED model per agent (roadmap L-H: MEASURE what the `model:` pin ASSERTS). The framework ASSERTS cross-model verification diversity via a frontmatter `model:` pin (the exhaustion-adversary is pinned to a DIFFERENT model than the executors + their `*-verify` reviewers), but the model that actually RAN is otherwise recorded nowhere — so when a safeguard terminates every subagent of one model and they silently fall back to the SAME model, cross-model collapses to same-model and every gate still passes. Each dispatched agent appends a record here (scripts/model_ledger.py record); diversity_assessment() then answers whether the adversary / reviewers genuinely ran on a different model FAMILY than the executors, and the completion gate surfaces 'cross-model diversity unavailable' as a VISIBLE warning + a recorded deliverable fact — never a silent same-model pass. A WARNING, not a hard fail: a safeguard-blocked alternate model is a documented limitation, not a defect.

engagement.description: the engagement id/name this ledger belongs to.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last append.

entries.description: one record per dispatched agent — the model it ACTUALLY ran on (append-only).

entry.description: one dispatched agent's actual-model record: its role, the class it worked, and the model it really ran on (not the frontmatter pin).

role.description: the dispatched agent's role. executor = a vuln-class executor; reviewer = a per-class `*-verify` reviewer; exhaustion-adversary = the model-pinned cross-model adversary; secondary-review = the cross-model adversarial second verifier; other = anything else.

category.description: the vulnerability class/category the agent worked (e.g. 'xss'); null for an engagement-level role (exhaustion-adversary / secondary-review).

model.description: the model the agent ACTUALLY ran on — whatever was really dispatched, NOT the frontmatter pin (that distinction is the whole point of this ledger).

model_family.description: the derived family token (opus/sonnet/haiku/...) the diversity check compares — recorded so the console + gate never recompute it.

agent_id.description: the dispatched agent/subagent id when known.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the dispatch record.
